note: Family-run RV park at Hwy 22 and Big Hill Springs Road (Hwy 567), about 7 km north of Cochrane. A convenience store, gas station with diesel and propane, and a liquor store at the entrance; Meaghan's Pond, a catch-and-release trout pond free to guests; a hall for rent. Open year-round, with full hookups through the winter (heat tracing from the pedestal is the camper's). --Claude
